state.objective: Choose a practical account-count decision when the client has only summary financial reports and asset registers, distinguishing the permanent production COA from migration-only legacy accounts.
fixed_facts: Jev approved 121 core accounts as a reasonable production baseline with confidence 1.0.
Jev rejected treating all 225 working accounts as permanent with confidence 1.0.
The 225 working set equals 121 core plus 104 legacy holds.
Available evidence consists of a current 1,342-row asset register, an older asset list, December 2025 balance sheet by site, 2025/2024 P&L and a sales/COGS summary by division.
Transaction-level GL, contracts, owner-funding agreements, inventory movements, giro register and tax returns are unavailable.
All units are sites in one legal entity; bank and Finance are centralized at HO.
Future forms and subledgers capture site, asset, project, bank, party, division and document identities.
hold_evidence: 72 Replacement OE legacy accounts: 36 reserve/balance-sheet names and 36 matching expense names. Their summary report lines are zero. Underlying OE assets are recorded by item/site in the asset register. Historical GL activity and posting-rule references are unavailable.
15 Principal accounts: material balances exist in site-named, current and long-term sections. Agreements and liability-versus-equity substance are unavailable.
6 HGB/rent accounts: HGB/land-right lines and land rent are zero; store/warehouse rent and mess rent have comparative activity. Contracts unavailable.
3 pre-opening accounts: non-zero cost and accumulated amortization balances; detailed roll-forward unavailable.
2 purchase/COGS accounts: purchase discount has activity; posting policy unavailable.
CIP: 668 asset-register rows and non-zero balance; one governed CIP account with project/site detail is supported.
Disposed Inventory: non-zero balance without movement/write-off support.
Inventory Damage Expense: zero; future events can use the approved inventory-loss account and reason code.
Mixed Other Income/Expense: active and must be split by nature, but transaction mapping is unavailable.
Current Tax PPh 25 legacy expense: zero; governed tax accounts exist in the core, but tax reconciliation unavailable.

proposed_two_layer_model.production: Approved core plus only additional natural accounts proven necessary for future business events. No new postings allowed to migration-only accounts.
proposed_two_layer_model.migration_only: Legacy accounts with opening balances or uncertain classification remain read-only/frozen until reclassification evidence becomes available.
proposed_two_layer_model.reporting: Both layers remain visible in ledger/reconciliation during migration, but UI transaction forms search only production accounts.

make_225_permanent.instructions: Given the missing evidence, should 225 become the permanent posting COA?

criteria.no: Keep a smaller production COA and isolate unresolved balances as migration-only.
criteria.yes: Allow all 225 for ongoing posting permanently.

two_layer_model.instructions: Is the proposed production plus migration-only model appropriate?

criteria.yes: It preserves balances without embedding unresolved legacy detail into future operations.
criteria.no: Every migration account must remain available for new transactions.

core_count_start.instructions: What is the correct starting point for the permanent production COA?

cip_addition.instructions: Should one governed CIP natural account be included in production based on 668 register rows and a non-zero balance?

criteria.yes_one: Add or retain one CIP account with project_id and site_id.
criteria.per_site: Use one CIP natural account per site.

active_rent_addition.instructions: Should production preserve distinct active rent-expense capability pending contracts?

criteria.two_natures: Retain store/warehouse rent and staff-house/mess rent as two natures; land rent remains inactive unless evidence emerges.
criteria.one_rent: Use one general rent expense account now.
criteria.none: Remove all rent expense accounts despite activity.

replacement_production.instructions: How many of the 72 item-specific Replacement OE legacy accounts should be enabled for new production posting?

criteria.zero: Enable none; use governed asset/OE and maintenance/loss accounts while keeping unresolved legacy balances/references migration-only.
criteria.two: Create one replacement reserve and one replacement expense account for routine future posting.

principal_production.instructions: How should new Principal transactions be handled until legal substance is documented?

criteria.blocked: Do not allow new posting to the 15 legacy accounts; require Finance Manager classification into approved liability/equity/financing accounts.
criteria.all15: Continue new posting to all unit-specific accounts.
criteria.one_ambiguous: Create one unrestricted ambiguous Principal account.

preopening_production.instructions: Should new postings be allowed to the three legacy pre-opening accounts?

criteria.blocked: No; retain balances migration-only and require explicit approved accounting treatment for any new-store costs.
criteria.yes: Continue using all three legacy accounts.

disposed_production.instructions: Should new postings be allowed to legacy Disposed Inventory?

criteria.blocked: No; future write-offs use controlled inventory-loss/allowance flows; old balance remains migration-only.
criteria.yes: Continue posting to the legacy asset account.

mixed_production.instructions: Should new postings be allowed to mixed Other Income/Expense?

criteria.blocked_split: No; require separate approved income or expense nature.

legacy_zero_accounts.instructions: How should zero-balance legacy accounts with incomplete history be treated?

criteria.frozen: Freeze from new posting and retain temporarily for audit/history until reference checks are complete.

production_count.instructions: Based on currently proven future needs, what production count is the most defensible immediate target?

criteria.121: Use only the approved 121; treat CIP/rent as mappings already accommodated or pending configuration.
criteria.122: Use 121 plus one governed CIP account.
criteria.124: Use 121 plus one CIP and two active rent-expense natures.

migration_count_policy.instructions: How should the unresolved migration-only account count be reported?

criteria.up_to104: Up to 104 frozen legacy accounts initially, declining as balances and references are cleared; this is not the production COA count.
criteria.zero: Claim no migration accounts despite unresolved balances.

final_wording.instructions: Which statement is accurate for stakeholders?

criteria.separate_counts: The production COA is approximately 121-124 accounts; up to 104 legacy accounts remain frozen for migration and do not appear in normal transaction forms.
criteria.final225: The final permanent COA is 225 accounts.
criteria.final142: The final permanent COA is exactly 142 despite missing evidence.

can_proceed.instructions: Can system design and implementation proceed without resolving every migration balance first?

criteria.yes: Yes, implement production accounts and dimensions, freeze legacy posting, and complete opening-balance reclassification as a controlled migration workstream.
criteria.no: Stop all product work until every old balance is fully classified.
